description: This file is a shell script used for testing Git rebase behaviors, including handling of commit messages and diffs. It sets up various test scenarios for Git rebase commands, manipulating commits, messages, and branches.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting success, executing the provided shell commands.

methods.name: test_expect_success 'rebase commit with multi-line subject'
methods.description: Runs a rebase command and compares commit messages to verify multi-line subject handling.

methods.name: test_expect_success 'rebase commit with diff in message'
methods.description: Performs a rebase and compares commit messages with diffs included.

methods.name: test_expect_success 'rebase -m commit with empty message'
methods.description: Tests rebase with an empty commit message using '-m'.

methods.name: test_expect_success 'rebase -i commit with empty message'
methods.description: Tests interactive rebase with an empty commit message and fake editor.
